(A) [0.3802, 0.6524, 0.5402, 0.8124]
(B) [0.6787, 0.6703, 0.8387, 0.8303]
(C) [0.1275, 0.0424, 0.2875, 0.2024]
(D) No building change in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
